steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Multiply. Availability, performance and quality are multiplied into OEE, and each is checked to 100 percent.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Week with missing data
findings.fix: Add the data for the week

outcome.notChecked: Whether the definition matches the client's.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.

[high] oee-avail.csv:12  Component above 100 percent.
       Fix: Correct the component.
[medium] oee-quality.csv:19  OEE with a missing component.
       Fix: Add the missing component.
[low] oee-line-b.csv:26  Week with missing data.

Not checked: Whether the definition matches the client's.
pros: Checks a component above 100 percent, an OEE with a missing component, and a week with missing data.
cons: Not checked: Whether the definition matches the client's.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-mfg-weekly-oee-report skill on the records for this review.
